About this item

  • Bluetooth Call & Alexa Built-in: Powered by a Bluetooth 5.3 chip and equipped with built-in Alexa, HD speakers and a microphone, smart watch not only allows you to make/answer calls directly from your wrist, but also to give commands through voice assistance. Meanwhile, it supports receiving text messages and notifications from applications.(Unable to reply to messages)
  • 1.83'' HD Screen & Over 130 Dials: Smart watches for men is equipped with 1.83'' TFT-LCD touchscreen with 240*284 resolution, which has excellent visual effect and touch experience. Smartwatch has over 130 beautiful dials for you to choose from, you can change it at any time according to your mood and preference, or you can DIY it by yourself
  • 24/7 Health & Activity Montioring: Equipped with advanced heart rate, sleep, the fitness tracker can monitor your various body metrics and activities throughout the day (steps, distance, calories, etc.). All recorded data will be synchronized to your phone and apps to help you develop healthier habits and lifestyle
  • 120+ Sport Modes & IP68 Waterproof: Watch for men providess 120+ sports modes, covering running, walking, biking, yoga, pilates, etc., which can meet different users' sports needs. It can record calories burned, steps, distance and exercise time during exercise. It also has IP68 waterproof performance to meet the needs of daily life use
  • More Functions & Long Battery Life: Fitness watch has a variety of useful functions such as alarm clock, stopwatch, flashlight, water reminder, music control, camera control, weather forecast, find cell phone and more. It has a built-in 300 mAh battery, which can be used for 8-10 days after charging for 2 hours, and the standby time is 30 days
